name: Azure Lilies
description: The azure lilies expel a burst of toxic pollen.
disable: DC 33 Nature or DC 33 Survival (expert) to harvest the plant's pollen without disturbing the blossoms.

generalAbilities.name: Pollen Burst
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The lily patch is disturbed

Effect The pollen erupts in a 30-foot-radius burst. Any living creature in the burst must attempt a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save, though creatures with the plant trait are immune.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 6d6 Mental Damage damage as the pollen causes wracking headaches and jolts of pain.

Failure The creature takes 12d6 Mental Damage damage and is Confused for 1 minute. The creature can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion early.

Critical Failure The creature takes 20d6 Mental Damage damage and is confused for 1 minute, with no save to end the confusion early.
